abstract: To clarify the role of ovarian teratomas in the pathogenesis of anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis, we examined histopathologically ovarian teratomas with and without encephalitis as well as normal ovaries. We found strong expression of N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor subtype 2B (NR2B) epitopes in the cytoplasm of oocytes obtained from human and bovine ovaries. A substantial amount of neural tissues expressing NR2B immunoreactivity chiefly in the mature neurons was observed. However, between both groups of ovarian teratomas, no significant difference in either the amount of neural tissues or the degree of inflammatory cell infiltration was observed. Young females comprise around 80% of all anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients, and it has been reported that 39% of them have ovarian teratomas. It is also well known that the vast majority of encephalitis patients have prodromal infection before onset of the disease. If this infection affects either normal ovaries or ovarian teratomas, it may trigger the expression of NMDAR-related epitopes in oocytes. Therefore, ovarian teratomas that consist of large amounts of neural tissue might indicate an increased risk for development of this type of intractable encephalitis.
abstract_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の病態における卵巣奇形腫の役割を明らかにするため、脳炎を伴う卵巣奇形腫と伴わない卵巣奇形腫、および正常卵巣を病理組織学的に検討した。ヒトおよびウシの卵巣由来の卵母細胞の細胞質に、N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体サブタイプ2B(NR2B)エピトープの強い発現を認めた。NR2B免疫反応性を示す神経組織が多く認められ、その大部分は成熟神経細胞であった。しかし、両群の奇形腫の間で、神経組織量にも炎症細胞浸潤の程度にも有意な差は認められなかった。抗NMDA受容体脳炎の患者の約80%は若年女性であり、そのうち39%に卵巣奇形腫が認められるとの報告がある。また脳炎患者の大部分は発症前に先行感染を有することもよく知られている。この感染が正常卵巣または卵巣奇形腫に影響を及ぼし、卵母細胞でのNMDAR関連エピトープの発現を誘導する可能性がある。したがって、神経組織に富む卵巣奇形腫は、この種の難治性脳炎の発症リスクの増加を示唆するかもしれない。
